About EchoIQ

Your message passes through a chain of unreliable messengers. Each personality changes what they hear, so the words you choose and the order of your messengers matter.

How to play

  1. Choose a campaign and select three messengers.
  2. Arrange the messengers in the order you want your message to travel.
  3. Craft your wording to protect the important facts and see what arrives.
